_readme: Lead Finder settings. Edit values, keep keys. Your Google API key goes in the .env file (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=...), never here.
_cost_note: Google's list prices when this was written: Places Text Search (Enterprise fields: phone, website, rating, hours) about $35 per 1,000 requests, Geocoding about $5 per 1,000, each with a monthly free allowance. Check https://mapsplatform.google.com/pricing/ and update these numbers.
